annotations.exact_quote: Our approach over-clusters data into fine-grained sub-clusters, applies dual-frequency filtering to preserve structural information, and merges them into target clusters via a learnable assignment.

annotations.exact_quote: The resulting aggregation process provides guidance signals for representation learning, enabling reliable sample selection with class-balanced weights and an adaptive push-away loss that explicitly separates majority and minority representations.
